2026-09-09.content: * Promoted developer-knowledge commands to the beta track.

summary.title: Developer knowledge commands now in beta
summary.summary: The developer-knowledge commands have been promoted to the beta track. This means they are now available for broader testing and feedback before a general availability release. Users can explore these features and contribute to their refinement.

2026-09-09.content: * Added `--tags` flag to `gcloud beta parametermanager parameters create` to allow binding tags during parameter creation.

summary.title: Tagging for Parameters
summary.summary: You can now bind tags to parameters when creating them using the `--tags` flag in `gcloud beta parametermanager parameters create`. This enhances parameter organization and management.

2026-09-09.content:
* Added `gcloud policy-troubleshoot error-info-id` to troubleshoot access denials using an IAM error identifier.

Subscribe to these release notes at <https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/google-cloud-sdk-announce>.

summary.title: Troubleshoot access denials with error info
summary.summary: You can now troubleshoot access denials more easily using the new `gcloud policy-troubleshoot error-info-id` command. This command leverages an IAM error identifier to help you diagnose and resolve permission issues.
